name: Chain Veil
description: The Chain Veil is an evil artifact of fine chain mesh, haunted by the spirits of the Onakke dead, that empowers its wielder, notably Liliana Vess, at a bloody cost.

description_citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

summary.text: The Chain Veil is an evil artifact of fine chain mesh, haunted by the spirits of the Onakke dead, that empowers its wielder, notably Liliana Vess, at a bloody cost.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Liliana used the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, but she was bound to it and could not leave it behind.

citations.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.
"Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

bio.text: On Shandalar she tried to return it to its altar, but could not let go of it, and an Onakke spirit called her a vessel.

citations.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.
"Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

bio.text: On Innistrad it amplified her magic and she could no longer bear to wear it but could not get rid of it without unbearable pain, and an attempt to tame it with geist circuitry failed.

citations.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.
"Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Against Emrakul she drew deeply on it, then refused to be a vessel and silenced the Veil.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: On Amonkhet it kept Razaketh from activating her contract, and Bolas offered to teach her to master it.

citations.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.
"Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

bio.text: On Dominaria she drew on it to kill undead across the Morass, and it destroyed Josu.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

bio.text: In the Echoverse, Garruk's double carries it, and Ajani ripped it away, while the Legends account has Garruk donning it in the Onakke Catacombs after being tempted by Kothophed.

citations.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story, the Chain Veil is worn by Garruk after Kothophed tempted him in the Onakke Catacombs.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives on Shandalar, tormented by the Chain Veil's voices, and heads for the Onakke catacomb she has visited before.
timeline.quote: all she could hear was the veil.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
timeline.quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her first visit, when she killed her horse's attacker and used the veil to infect Garruk with shadow, after which he hunted her to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She'd used it to infect him with shadow, polluting his nature magic with the touch of death.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: At the catacomb Liliana kills a guarding angel, who warns her of the Onakke and that she is a vessel.
timeline.quote: She punctuated her words with a killing wave of raw necromantic power that flayed flesh from the angel's bones

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana tries to return the Chain Veil to its altar but cannot let go of it.
timeline.quote: She tried to open her hand, to let the thing drop, but her fingers wouldn't obey her will.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises an Onakke skeleton to take the veil, but it will not leave and she destroys it; the veil ends up hanging from her arm.
timeline.quote: She stared at the veil in horror as bones clattered to the floor all around her.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
timeline.quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains the Chain Veil's power to extinguish the Onakke spirit at great pain but still cannot drop the veil.
timeline.quote: And like a snuffed candle flame, the spirit vanished.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves Shandalar, still carrying the veil and its whispers, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had taken into herself the one thing she had spent her whole life trying to avoid.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first taking his body and the second his spark, and the folly of seeking the Veil.
timeline.quote: The first robbed me of my body. The second of my spark.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Liliana dine at Milena's, where she shows him the Chain Veil and he cannot take it.
timeline.quote: you can't take it, even if I wanted you to.

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand and being unable to leave it behind.
timeline.quote: It was bound to her, and her to it.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts the Raven Man in a flare of magic, then raises the dead ravens as zombies that tear his reformed flock apart and drive him away.
timeline.quote: The bird in her hand squirmed and wriggled free, now a tiny zombie bound to her will.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
timeline.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana can no longer bear to wear the Chain Veil, but cannot get rid of it without unbearable pain.
timeline.quote: But when she tried to get rid of it, the pain was unbearable.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil amplifies her magic and backlash racks Liliana as Jace presses his mental assault.
timeline.quote: The backlash started, agony suffusing Liliana as the Chain Veil took its toll.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes that Liliana is redirecting mana to the Drownyard to be rid of the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: These stone things are redirecting all this mana, and it's all going to this drownyard henge

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Gared tells Liliana that his master bids her come to the tower with the Object.
timeline.quote: The Master bids you come to the tower,

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana follows Gared up the tower stairs with the Chain Veil, while a raven watches and vanishes.
timeline.quote: Liliana walked upward, into darkness.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Dierk and Gared try to tame the Chain Veil by channeling lightning and geists through a witchbane orb.
timeline.quote: Liliana's teeth clenched involuntarily as the surge came.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The geist circuit fails to draw off any backlash, and the Veil's pain overwhelms Liliana.
timeline.quote: The geist circuit had not drawn off any of the backlash.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
timeline.quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
timeline.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
timeline.quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana feels the Chain Veil in its hidden pocket and the whispering spirits inside it.
timeline.quote: She laid a hand over the hidden pocket where she kept the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Tezzeret's life using the Chain Veil and her zombie attacks him.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret clutched at his throat and fell to his knees

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
timeline.quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
timeline.quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
timeline.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
timeline.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
timeline.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Veil destroys Josu, leaving his decomposing corpse.
timeline.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil blasts away the preserved manor, aging it into ruin.
timeline.quote: the Chain Veil had blasted it all away, aging the house until it was a crumbled ruin.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls the dead of an old massacre site to raise an undead army as a diversion.
timeline.quote: And in the grass and reeds and brush below, the dead stirred.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The friends beat their doubles, Garruk knocks down the cryomancer, Ajani rips away the Chain Veil, and Chandra sends fire.
timeline.quote: roaring as he rips the ancient artifact away with a swipe of his claws.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tempted by Kothophed, Garruk dons the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs.
timeline.quote: Tempted by the offer, Garruk donned the Chain Veil, an artifact of evil soul-binding magic.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: Bound to the Veil and cannot be rid of it.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

relations.note: Liliana still has the Chain Veil.
relations.quote: I still have the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

relations.note: She keeps it hidden in a pocket; it whispers to her and she cannot discard it.
relations.quote: It whispered to her, even now, from the hidden pocket where she kept it.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

relations.note: She wields it and draws on its power despite the pain.
relations.quote: Without conscious thought she drew deep on the power of the Chain Veil

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

relations.note: She carries the Chain Veil hidden in a pocket.
relations.quote: She laid a hand over the hidden pocket where she kept the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

relations.quote: The sight of the Chain Veil alarms Liliana

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An evil artifact of fine chain mesh from Shandalar's Onakke, which empowers Liliana but whispers constantly and refuses to let go of her.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

pages_say.description: A weapon Ob Nixilis seized when young, which he says can only destroy the one who wields it.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

pages_say.description: A very powerful, ancient, cursed artifact that turns users into vessels for a long-dead race and demons.

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

pages_say.description: A powerful artifact that drains Liliana's strength, binds the Onakke spirits' voices to her mind, and cannot be left behind.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

pages_say.description: A looming problem that only planeswalkers can handle.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

pages_say.description: An artifact that Liliana still has.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

pages_say.description: A silken-linked artifact that amplifies Liliana's necromancy, with which she killed two demons and took Thraben; it whispers to her, hurts to wear or discard, and is called the Object by her master.

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

pages_say.description: A necromantic artifact containing thousands of souls whose backlash cannot be tamed by geist circuitry.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

pages_say.description: An object Liliana carries that hovers near her fingertips; Nissa calls it an abomination and Gideon calls it a problem.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: An artifact Liliana wields whose power splits her skin and which whispers 'vessel of destruction, root of evil' and urges her to flee Emrakul.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: The artifact Liliana keeps hidden in a pocket, possessed by whispering Onakke spirits.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: An artifact whose power Liliana draws on at a bloody cost.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

pages_say.description: An artifact at Liliana's side whose purple glow envelops her when she emerges from the wurm.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

pages_say.description: An evil relic of tremendous power that Liliana carries; it protects her and prevents Razaketh from activating her contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

pages_say.description: A relic Liliana carries at her side but chooses not to use against Razaketh.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

pages_say.description: A relic carrying the spirits of the Onakke dead that Liliana uses at risk of death or subjugation and that Bolas claims he can unlock.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

pages_say.description: An Onakke artifact that lets Liliana kill demons but saps her strength.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

pages_say.description: An artifact binding Onakke spirits that destroys undead and demons at the cost of Liliana's strength.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

pages_say.description: The artifact that drained Liliana's strength.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

pages_say.description: An artifact containing Onakke spirits that whisper to Liliana.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

pages_say.description: An artifact with Onakke spirits that Liliana cannot safely use yet.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

pages_say.description: An artifact Liliana once used and was freed of.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

pages_say.description: An artifact whose violet glow marks Garruk's double.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An artifact carried by Garruk's double that alarms Liliana.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An artifact of evil soul-binding magic donned by Garruk, Veiled Butcher.
